prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all tested kinds of changes (choose_path copy, finish copy, home wait_info) as each only has a single test.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to the noise-corrected measurements across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Spotlight Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen layout into a high-visibility spotlight layout with animated choice cards and clear path descriptions. (why: choose_path has a huge mean time (514s) indicating users stall or get confused when choosing how to get their pet.)
1: [home, new_screen] Interactive Waiting Activity Screen: Add a new interactive minigame screen 'new_waiting_game' while the desktop pet is generating, giving users instant mini-interactions. (why: The waiting home step takes median 201s and mean 2336s, driving high drop-off before finishing onboarding.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Pet Style Selector Flow: Introduce a new visual styling sub-flow 'new_pet_style' right before adoption certificate creation to customize pet appearance and behavior. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Shift: Reorder the sign_in screen to occur right after adoption certificate generation rather than before selecting/creating a pet. (why: 72.9% sign_in conversion shows early sign-in friction before users build emotional attachment to their chosen pet.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Progress & Time Estimator: Show dynamic time estimates, progress bar, and active desktop setup tips on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait time averages 2336s, causing uncertainty and user abandonments.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Controls Onboarding Guide: Display explicit desktop interaction hints on home_intro showing how to click, move, talk to, or hide the pet on screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their new pet.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Overlay Ready Notification: Enable desktop notification alert and mascot welcome audio cue when home_intro completes. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on the desktop or failing to render upon setup finish.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Incentive Copy: Update choose_path text to highlight instant readiness versus custom photo pet creation options. (why: High mean completion time (514s) indicates ambiguity during path selection.)

scores.note: Targeted choose_path step has high stall time (514s), but new screen layout requires a full release with no support mail backing.
High wait time at home step causes drop-offs, but introducing a minigame requires a new screen release with only funnel evidence.
Adoption has the biggest drop (39.1% loss) and 3 support emails, making potential impact high despite needing a new sub-flow.
Reordering sign_in tackles 27.1% drop-off by deferring friction until after emotional attachment, backed by funnel data.
Home step loses 18.7% with long wait, but prior test for home wait_info showed negligible lift (+0.1%).
Finish loses 35.2% of users and 3 support tickets highlight control confusion; cheap hint UI update.
Finish loses 35.2% and 3 support emails note pets missing/failing to render; notification UI fix is medium effort.
Config-only copy change targeting 514s stall time; prior test of choose_path copy measured +2.7% relative lift.
